docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Natesa Sastri’s collection of the folk tales and legends of the Tamil country, taken down from the storytellers in the 1880s (Bombay, 1884). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Folklore in southern India · Natesa Sastri, S. M., 1859-1906 · 1884, 344 scanned pages. Published 1884; S. M. Natesa Sastri died 1906; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
